response:
For MR diagnosis of bone metastases at 1.5 T and 3 T, the standard imaging protocol can be safely limited to the T1-weighted (T1w) sequence, especially at 3 T. There is no need for an additional STIR (Short-Tau Inversion Recovery) sequence.

This conclusion is based on the analysis of retrieved matches from a local dataset. At both 1.5 T and 3 T, using the T1w sequence can help identify bone metastases effectively. The absence of STIR imaging at these lower field strengths does not compromise image quality for detecting bone metastases.
